title: fynkel.Animator
description: Plays one clip over the entity's subtree (M3-19, `docs/animation.md`): every channel of `clip` drives the first descendant (the entity itself included) named like the channel's target, in the pre-tick slot, so physics and the catalogue see the posed transforms this tick. `speed` scales time (negative plays backwards); a `looping` clip wraps, one that is not stops at its last key with `playing` cleared and an `ANIMATION_ENDED` event. `Command::Animate` plays, crossfades, stops, pauses, resumes, re-speeds and seeks it from Dart; the world must know the clip (`World::register_clip`; the loaders register every clip a loaded scene's animators name, `CLIP_UNAVAILABLE` once otherwise).
